title: Vegeta and Mushroom Bhuna
description: A French-inspired twist on the classic Indian dish, featuring tender vegeta and a rich bhuna sauce.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the vegeta and cook until heated through.
Stir in the bhuna and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
